# wef-notch 0.3.1
The first update to come through wef-notch itself. Nothing in the app changed: this Release only shows that updating works.
If you're reading this in the update window, it worked. Install it, and the app opens again as 0.3.1.

# wef-notch 0.3.0
wef-notch now updates itself. This is the last time you install it by hand.
## Installing this version
1. Quit wef-notch: point at the notch, click the bar, press the gear, then **Quit wef-notch** (or right-click the notch and choose **Quit**). 2. Download `wef-notch-0.3.0.zip` below and double-click it. 3. Drag `wef-notch.app` into **Applications** and choose **Replace**. 4. Open it from Applications. macOS says it can't be opened, because the app isn't notarized by Apple yet: press **Done**, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, press **Open Anyway** beside *wef-notch was blocked*, confirm, and open it again. Only this once.
Your Note, to-do list, files, Theme and settings stay as they were.
## What's new
- **Updates come to you.** The second time you open the app, it asks whether it may check for updates by itself. When an update is out, Settings → About says **Update available**; click it to see what's new and install. The app replaces itself and opens again. macOS may ask for your Mac's password once while it does. - **Check for Updates…** in About checks right away. - **Check automatically** in About turns the daily check on or off. A check sends only the app's version.
